Governing document: the WSU / AAUP-AFT Local 6075 Agreement, March 20, 2013 - March 20, 2021 (2018_06, full PDF text; 2018_01/02/03/05 are the union's web copies of Articles XIII, I, XXXVII and XXII, captured 2018-05-11). The bargaining unit includes all teaching faculty at half-time or more (assistant, associate, full professors), so its provisions cover main-campus tenure-stream faculty. missing = false: a governing collective agreement for faculty leave is saved.
2018_09 is a benefits Q&A (no entitlement); 2018_10 is the FMLA page (administration by FMLASource, links).
Article XIII in 2018_06 and the union web copy 2018_01 carry the same text; quotes from Article XIII are taken from 2018_01 and the full agreement is cited alongside.

Childbirth period: XIII.D.1 places pregnancy and childbirth disability under Short-Term Disability Leave for Illness (C.1: full compensation; for a two-year member up to 66 working days in any twelve-month period). The HR site's leave guide (2018_00, version_uncertain, per the document's version note) states the period as 'typically 8 weeks for both Natural and Caesarean Delivery'. Coded per V1b's Wayne State example as an employer_childbirth_benefit of 8 weeks (c2), within the disability leave coded under U6 (c1). The combination of U6 and V1b on one provision is flagged as a rule gap on c1.

Modified duties (c3) is discretionary ('may be granted'), for the parent with primary responsibility (certified), one semester capped at 15 weeks including the disability leave; coded one semester per R3b's Wayne State example, teaching relieved, research continuing (Just teaching). A reduced-workload plan may carry a compensation adjustment up to $3,000 and/or in-load make-up teaching within three semesters; flagged.

Chain, birth parent: modified-duties semester c3 (discretionary) containing the Short-Term Disability Leave c1 (up to 66 working days, guaranteed) containing the paid childbirth period c2 (typically 8 weeks, full compensation); FMLA c11 concurrent with c1 from its start; then, after the disability bank, discretionary unpaid medical leave c8 consecutive_after c1, or a fractional return c10 consecutive_after c1; parent leave without pay c6 (discretionary, up to 12 months) unlinked.

Chain, non-birth parent: FMLA c11 (12 workweeks, unpaid; its link to c1 is ignored for this role) from the birth; modified-duties semester c3 (discretionary, primary caregiver) unlinked; family emergency-care paid days c12 (up to 5 working days) unlinked; parent leave without pay c6 (discretionary) unlinked.

Leave of absence without pay (XIII.A) is coded three ways by its anchors: as the parent leave of XIII.D.3 (c6), as the general professional/personal leave (c7, general_purpose), and as medical leave after the disability bank for members declining LTD (c8, XII.H.4). The tenure-clock exclusion of any unpaid leave (A.1.d) is c5 (general_purpose).

Not components: bereavement leave (XIII.C.3.b), jury duty, military leave, authorized professional absences, sabbatical leaves, academic-staff professional development time, training leave on layoff (cannot be taken for a birth); mandatory sick leave (XIII.C.2, imposed by the University, not a benefit); stopping the clock 'for other professional reasons' (XIII.D.5, second paragraph; not for a birth); the 2016-17 HR Leaves of Absence Q&A (benefit continuation only); APPM 3.3.6 (refers to union agreements and the Personnel Manual for All Non represented Personnel). The summer-payroll clause of C.1.a (STD at the summer rate within the summer appointment) is noted, not coded.
